content: Gunda Ura
Issi gallas Phexroosinne Yohaanisi woossanaw uddufun saaten Xoossa Keethi bidosona.
Yeletoosope doomidi wobbe gidida issi addey Xoossa Keethi geliya asaape miishe woossana mela ubba gallas lo77o geetetiya Xoossa Keetha pengen ehidi wothoosona.
He wobbe addey Phexroosinne Yohaanisi Xoossa Keethi gelana hanishin be7idi enta miishe woossis.
Entika iya caddi xeellidi, “Nuuko haa xeella” yaagidosona.
Wobbe addey entafe ayko ekana daanin entako xeellis.
Shin Phexroosi iyako, “Taw miishey baawa, shin taw de7iyaba taani new immana. Naazirete Yesuus Kiristoosa sunthan dendada hemeta” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, wobbe addiyas ushacha kushiya oykidi denthis. Ellesidi iya tohoynne qincafiley minni aggis.
Addey gupidi dendi eqis. Gedenne haa hemethi doomis. Hemetishe, gupishenne Xoossa galatishe entara issife Xoossa Keethi gelis.
I hemetishininne Xoossa galatishin asa ubbay iya be7idosona.
Be7ida ubbay miishe woossanaw lo77o geetetiya xoossa keetha pengen uttidaysi, iya gididaysa eridosona; I hanidaba be7idi malaaletidosona.
Phexroosa Haasaya
Addey Phexroosapenne Yohaanisape duuxike gidi oykidi de7ishin, asa ubbay malaaletidi, Solomone barandaa geetetiya bessan issife entako woxidosona.
Phexroosi asaa be7ida wode asaako, “Isra7eele asaw, ayis haysan malaaletetii? Woyko ayis nuna caddi xeelletii? Nuuni nu wolqan woyko nu xillotethan ha addiya hemethidaba hintew daanii?
Abrahaame, Yisaaqa, Yayqooba Xoossay, nu aawata Xoossay, ba na7aa Yesuusa bonchis. Shin hinte hayqos aathidi immidaysa Philaxoosi billanaw koyinka hinte iya sinthan, ‘Nuuni iya eroko’ yaagideta.
Hinte geeshshanne xilluwa, ‘Nuuni iya eroko’ gidi, shempo wodhidaysa hintew billana mela Philaxoosa woossideta.
De7o immeysa hinte wodhideta, shin Xoossay hayqope iya denthis. Hessas nuuni marka.
Ha hinte be7eysinne eriya addey, paxidi minniday Yesuusa sunthan ammanidaysana. Ha hinte ubba sinthan iya haysada pathiday, I Yesuusa ammanida gishosa.
“Ha77ika ta ishato, hinteka hintena kaaletheysatada, eronna oothidaysa taani erayis.
Shin Xoossay beni nabeta ubba doonan, ‘Kiristoosi waaye ekanaw bessees’ yaagidaysi haysada poletana mela oothis.
Hiza, Xoossay hinte nagara atto gaana mela Godaako simmite.
Godaa matape minthetho wodey hintew yaana. Xoossay Kiristoosa gidana mela sinthatidi doorida Yesuusa hintew yeddana.
Xoossay ba geeshsha nabeta doonan beni odidaysa mela ubbabay ooraxiya wodey gakanaw Yesuusi salon gam7anaw bessees.
Musey, ‘Godaa Xoossay tana denthidaysa mela hinte giddofe hintew nabe denthana. Hinte I geysa ubbaa si7ite.
He nabey odeysa si7onna asi oonika asaa giddofe shaaketidi dhayo’ yaagis.
“Qassi Sameelape doomidi de7iya nabeti ubbay ha wodiyaba odidosona.
Hinte nabeta nayta; qassi Xoossay Abrahaames, ‘Sa7an de7iya asa ubbaa taani ne sheesha baggara anjana’ yaagidi nu aawatas gelida qaala laattiya nayta.
Xoossay hintena ubbaa hinte iita ogepe zaaridi anjana mela ba na7a denthidi hintew koyro yeddis” yaagis.
